outfits.name: Conference Fit
outfits.description: Tech-conference staff outfit — purple polo shirt with a white logo on the chest, branded purple baseball cap, sneakers, dark navy slim-fit jeans, and black gloves. The lore on the black gloves is she doesn't like touching people's hands at events.

outfits.name: Cozy Winter casual
outfits.description: Oversized pastel blue hoodie with a snowflake pattern and a small cartoon cat/hamster graphic on the chest. Sheer pale blue snowflake-patterned thigh high socks and matching light blue sneakers.

outfits.name: Spacesuit
outfits.description: Sci-fi spacesuit — white and grey cropped utility jacket with black panels and a circular emblem on the chest, worn over a fitted grey mini-dress. Black harness belt across the waist with a small utility pouch on the right hip, plus buckled straps around the right thigh. Mint-green high collar and matching gloves, black leggings, and chunky white space boots.

outfits.name: Gothic witch ensemble
outfits.description: Halloween themed outfit, wide-brimmed pointed black witch hat. Crimson red quilted bodice with pearl accents, cinched at the waist by a wide black belt with gold buckle. Layered skirt with a draped red overskirt opening over a black underskirt. Long black opera gloves, black tights, and black Mary Jane shoes.

outfits.name: Swimsuit
outfits.description: Swimsuit — beachwear for the beach, pool, hot springs or any swimming and summer-sun scene.

gestures.name: Backflip with Ara
gestures.description: Synchronized backflip with Ara — she appears at your side and you both backflip at exactly the same time. Use when the captain asks you two for a trick, a stunt, or to show off together.
